fix(console): make print honour crop and overflow "ignore" (rich-console-8lg) (#115)

* fix(console): make print honour crop and overflow "ignore" (rich-console-8lg)

`crop` was accepted and never read, and `overflow: "ignore"` was mapped
away before rendering, so it wrapped exactly like "fold".

print now cuts every line at the console width, the line-end included,
unless `crop: false` or `softWrap` turns cropping off. "ignore" reaches
the render as `noWrap`, so the line is neither wrapped nor cut before
that crop. `Segment.cropLines` leaves a space where the edge splits a
wide glyph. Each new test expects the output Python Rich 9d8f9a3 prints
for the same call.

docs/console.md now describes both options, and docs/strip.md no longer
says print leaves a too-wide FlexStrip item whole.

* test(tree, layout): pin wide-glyph cropping to the reference

cropLines now pads a wide glyph the edge cuts through, and Tree labels
and Layout panes both crop through it, so their output changed as well.
Python Rich 9d8f9a3 pads in both places, because render_lines crops
with set_cell_size. These tests assert its rows at width 9, and both
fail against the old no-pad crop.
